method: candidate alpha silhouette cropped to its foreground bounding box, nearest-neighbor scaled into the pre-measured reference bounding box, then compared with knowledge_engine.visual_compare.compare_masks
interpretation: A row-width audit localized the remaining errors: an overly high shoulder, low guard wings, and over-wide grip/pommel. Typed corrections through revision 120 raised IoU from 0.7254 to 0.8285 without changing the target or comparison method.
